Give a User Payroll Access

User manual · English · 10 steps
Learn how to give a user officer access to the Payroll app by adding the right group to their record.

1. Open Settings

Open the Settings app.

2. Users & Companies

Open the Users & Companies menu.

3. Users

Click Users.

4. Find the user

Type the user's name and press Enter.

5. Open the user

Click the user to open the record.

6. Add a line

Click Add a line to give the user another group.

7. Find the group

Type "Manage all contracts" and press Enter.

8. Select the group

Tick the group in the list.

9. Confirm

Click Select to add it.

10. Save

Click the save icon to keep the change.
